name: Go service (API or worker)
description: Go 1.23+ module with standard layout, chi or net/http, sqlc or pgx, golangci-lint, table-driven tests. Optional HTMX or a separate frontend.

commands.check: gofmt -l . && go vet ./... && golangci-lint run && go test ./...

backend_conventions: Layout: `cmd/<binary>` for entry points, `internal/<domain>` for business logic, `internal/adapters` for I/O; domain packages import no I/O packages.
Interfaces are defined where they are used (consumer side); adapters satisfy them.
Errors are wrapped with context (`fmt.Errorf("...: %w", err)`) and checked with `errors.Is/As`; sentinel errors carry stable names.
Context is the first parameter of every function that does I/O.
Structured logging with `log/slog`; never log secrets or personal data.
Table-driven tests; fakes for interfaces; integration tests behind a build tag.
